rule: BUILT != PROVEN; PROVEN requires code/config plus production execution/readback evidence where applicable

gaps.name: Persisted canonical Business Graph
remaining: promote runtime store from Blob to canonical Supabase

gaps.name: Universal Action/Execution store
remaining: all external producers must emit canonical execution evidence

gaps.name: Company-wide Living Memory
remaining: all business domains must ingest documents/procedures/people/decisions as canonical objects

gaps.name: Persistent AI Governance registry
remaining: inventory every active AI use case/provider and periodic audit

gaps.name: Dynamic integration health/freshness/error/owner/cost/revision
remaining: continuous producer coverage for every integration

gaps.name: Full legacy calculation parity
remaining: fixtures and tolerance proof for every calculation

gaps.name: Production performance telemetry
remaining: minimum real-user sample coverage for all routes

hardBoundaries: Make organization/team paused by operations/data-transfer limit
Netlify Supabase service credentials not configured; never invent secrets
Credential-class Netlify Notion environment variable requires human-controlled rotation/secret hygiene
completionGate: No whole-brain completion until every non-intentional gap is PROVEN and every intentional hard boundary is represented as an enforced policy rather than bypassed.
